permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Used to look up the weather forecast for where you are. A single location fix is taken in the background; your coordinates are never shown on screen.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Downloads the weather forecast for your location from Open-Meteo, the on-device speech recognition model used for voice commands (downloaded once, then cached on the device), and, only if you add your own API key for the AI you choose (Google Gemini, DeepSeek or Anthropic Claude), sends what you ask Jarvis - and, in Jarvis Live, the transcript of the conversation - to that AI.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: While the app is open, listens on the glasses microphone for "Hey Jarvis" (you can turn this off), and records what you say to Jarvis after it or after a long-press so it can be recognised. All listening happens on your phone; audio is never stored, and nothing is sent anywhere until you speak to Jarvis.
